comment: Round 28 Q2 — shared canonical typed-UUID baseline. Several fixtures reference the same demo Space / event / Move / Anchor IDs to keep cross-fixture audit trails coherent. Fixtures that use these UUIDs SHOULD declare `inherits: ["_shared/_canonical_uuids.json"]` for discoverability. The UUIDs are valid UUIDv7 layouts (timestamp prefix + random tail) that match the spec's `cx:<kind>:<uuidv7>` typed wire format.

demo_space.comment: Reference Space used by anchor_view_compaction_fixture and event_kind_payload_coverage_fixture.

anchor_examples.comment: Symbolic SHA256 anchors used by state_resolution_quarantine_fixture for head_in chains.

event_id_prefix.comment: state_resolution_quarantine_fixture uses this prefix and increments the trailing 3 hex digits per vector.

ulid_examples.comment: Used by the bridge_contracts session-grant mock; not a real ULID, but stable across vectors.
